title: Guarded line-tool probe on a deterministic still image

input.provenance: Generated by tools/wine-oracle/generate-fixtures.py; deterministic synthetic PNG RGB, 1280x720.

preconditions: Use the verified existing win64 Wine prefix through the disposable overlay wrapper.
No Kinovea window may already be open.
The logged-in KWin/Xwayland session must accept guarded XTest clicks.

actions.description: Open the deterministic PNG using the established menu route.
Capture the player after opening the still image.
Fail if the expected still-image player is not visibly open.
Capture the player before tool selection.
Select the observed diagonal line-tool icon in the player drawing toolbar; the click is window-relative and focus-guarded.
Set the first line endpoint in the visible image canvas.
Set the second line endpoint in the visible image canvas.
Capture the result of the line creation attempt for manual review.

cleanup: Harness sends Alt+F4 only to the Kinovea window created by this run; it does not stop shared Wine services.
evidenceConfidence: The visible player header is OCR-checked. Tool selection and line creation require human screenshot review; clicks never imply success.
limitations: Toolbar location is specific to the captured 1920x969 Kinovea window geometry and this installed 2025.2.0.0 binary.
The screenshot does not establish image-space coordinates, numeric distance, calibration, or persisted drawing state.
The installed executable does not have established source correspondence with this checkout.

expectedOutcomes.observation: The existing still-image player is visibly opened.
A line-tool selection and two endpoint clicks produce a visible annotation.
expectedOutcomes.verification: MANUAL_REQUIRED screenshot review; do not infer success from click delivery.
